name: Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah
positioning: Beachfront resort on the Arabian Gulf with a New York-style steakhouse, family and adults-only pool areas, and a championship golf course next door
best_for: Golfers who want a championship course adjacent to the resort
Families who want a family pool and a children's area at breakfast
Couples wanting a beach lounge reserved for adults

facts.text: Lexington Grill & Bar is the signature restaurant: a New York steakhouse-style restaurant serving steaks, seafood and plant-based dishes.
Lexington Grill & Bar has a wine cellar.
Qasr Al Bahar serves breakfast and dinner, with floor-to-ceiling windows and an outdoor terrace.
Azure, beside the resort's main pool, serves Mediterranean food inspired by the coastlines of Italy, Greece, Turkey and beyond.
Sunset Beach Lounge sits by the infinity pool and the beach.
Palm Shore Pool Bar is beside the resort's family pool.
Executive Chef Michael Kreiling leads the hotel's kitchens.
On the Al Hamra golf course, four interconnected open water lagoons merge with the water of the Arabian Gulf.
Group and individual golf lessons are offered at Al Hamra Golf Club with PGA professional Damien Scott.
Al Hamra Golf Club facilities include indoor padel tennis courts.

highlights.text: At Lexington Grill & Bar guests can see the dry-age selection, hear a live band, and choose their own knife, salt and condiments.
Sunset Beach Lounge is a beachfront lounge reserved for adults.
The 18-hole Peter Harradine-designed championship course at Al Hamra Golf Club is adjacent to the resort.
Camelia Lounge sits in the grand lobby overlooking the Arabian Gulf and is known for its afternoon tea.
Al Hamra Golf Club uses floodlights so golfers can play a composite 9-hole course at night.

considerations.text: Golf is at the neighbouring Al Hamra Golf Club, adjacent to the resort rather than on the hotel grounds.
Sunset Beach Lounge is reserved for adults; families use the family pool, where Palm Shore Pool Bar is.
WhataHotel notes the location requires longer travel time from Dubai.
